# Prince Sarfo — Software Developer

> Personal portfolio of Prince Sarfo, a full-stack software developer based in Ghana who builds scalable web and mobile applications — from pixel-perfect frontends to reliable backend APIs.

- Site: https://princesarfo.dev
- Role: Full-Stack / Software Developer
- Location: Ghana
- Availability: Open to freelance work, full-time roles, and side projects

## About

Prince Sarfo is a Computer Science graduate from KNUST with hands-on experience building scalable web and mobile applications, REST and GraphQL APIs, and distributed systems. He works across the full stack — from UI to API to CI/CD — with a focus on clean code, great UX, and continuous learning.

## Skills

- **Frontend:** React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, React Native, Expo
- **Backend:** Node.js, NestJS, REST APIs, GraphQL, Firebase, PostgreSQL, Drizzle, Knex, JWT Auth
- **Tools & Infra:** Git, GitHub Actions, Netlify, DigitalOcean, Vercel, Figma, BullMQ

## Work Experience

- **Software Developer, Nyeova Systems** — Oct 2024–Present. Building and shipping products across web and mobile (PigeonUltra, PigeonFleet, PigeonUltra Admin, Pappysko, OneMillion), working full-stack from UI to API and CI/CD.
- **Software Intern, Mpact Lane Consult, Kumasi** — Sep 2023–Dec 2023. Built responsive web interfaces and user authentication flows.
- **Design Intern, Quality Image, Kumasi** — Sep 2022–Dec 2022. Designed social media graphics and edited images in Adobe Photoshop.

## Education

- **BSc. Computer Science, KNUST (Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology)** — Jan 2021–Sep 2024
- **W.A.S.S.C.E General Science, Asanteman Senior High School** — Oct 2016–Jun 2019

## Selected Projects

- **Schoolpedia** (https://schoolpedia.edcomrade.com/) — Ghana's national school directory and accreditation registry with search, comparison, interactive maps, and profile claiming. Next.js, TypeScript, NestJS, BullMQ.
- **Pioneers** (https://pioneers.edcomrade.com/) — School management system for administrators and educators to manage records, enrolment, and scheduling. Next.js, TypeScript, NestJS, BullMQ.
- **Kuro** (https://kuro.weorg.ai/) — Web and mobile app for residential communities in Africa. Next.js, React Native, TypeScript.
- **Bio-Tropical Ghana** (https://biotropicalghana.com/) — E-commerce site for an organic agricultural exporter, with product catalogue and wholesaler quote requests. Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
- **SYTO Ghana** (https://sytoghana.org/) — Platform connecting young people to educational travel and cultural exchange across Africa. Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
- **Pappysko** (https://pappysko.com/) — Property listing web app with Google Maps integration and full auth flows. React, Google Maps API, Node.js.
- **UniKonnect** — Campus events mobile app with Firebase auth/real-time database and Paystack ticket payments. Flutter, Firebase, Paystack.
- **SafePing** — Emergency safety app with OTP auth, real-time location sharing, and push notifications. React Native, Node.js, JWT, Expo.
- **OneMillion** — Cross-platform (web, mobile, desktop) donation platform. Next.js, React Native, Expo.
